reachability.rationale: Search (lista.mercadolivre.com.br) and product (/p/MLB) pages redirect plain HTTP clients to /captcha/wall. A logged-in Chrome session renders them fully. The generated CLI needs Chrome cookie import (auth login --chrome) plus a Chrome-fingerprint HTTP transport (Surf) to replay these GETs. No resident browser required at runtime.

surfaces.name: search
surfaces.notes: HTML document embeds application/ld+json @graph with ~48 Product entries + one SearchResultsPage. Each Product: name, brand.name, image, offers.price (numeric BRL), offers.availability, offers.url (product page, /p/MLB catalog id or /up/MLBU), aggregateRating {ratingValue, ratingCount}. Also embeds _n.ctx.s.q optimizedResponse blob and DOM poly-cards as fallback. Pagination: append _Desde_{offset} (49-per-page).

surfaces.name: product
surfaces.notes: JSON-LD Product: name, brand, sku (MLB id), aggregateRating {ratingValue, ratingCount, reviewCount}, offers {price, priceCurrency, availability, priceValidUntil, shippingDetails, hasMerchantReturnPolicy}. JSON-LD Table = full technical spec table. DOM spec table rows are 'Attribute :: Value' pairs (~40 attrs, e.g. 'Capacidade de disco SSD :: 1 TB'). BreadcrumbList = category path.

surfaces.name: categories_attributes
surfaces.notes: Official API, still open without auth. Returns the attribute SCHEMA for a category (which specs exist, required flags, value types). Used to build comparison column sets.

surfaces.name: domain_discovery
surfaces.notes: Official API, open without auth. Maps free-text query -> domain_id/category_id. Only search-ish official endpoint still public.

surfaces.name: autosuggest
surfaces.notes: Frontend static endpoint, open without auth. Returns suggested_queries[] with filters. Query expansion helper.

official_api_gated.note: Most of api.mercadolibre.com now returns 403 PolicyAgent without OAuth: /sites/MLB/search, /items/{id}, /products/search, /currencies, /sites, /categories list. Only /categories/{id}, /categories/{id}/attributes, /domain_discovery, autosuggest remain open. OAuth has no client_credentials flow (authorization_code + refresh only), so the website JSON-LD path is the chosen primary.
